title: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) & Preflight Diagnostic Specification
description: Formal specification for analyzing and validating CORS headers, preflight OPTIONS requests, credential permissions, wildcard combinations, and cache poisoning prevention according to the W3C Fetch Standard.

ERR_CORS_WILDCARD_WITH_CREDENTIALS.title: Wildcard Origin Forbidden with Credentials
ERR_CORS_WILDCARD_WITH_CREDENTIALS.description: The response specifies 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' while 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' is set to 'true'. Browsers reject this configuration for security reasons.

ERR_CORS_ORIGIN_MISMATCH.title: Origin Mismatch
ERR_CORS_ORIGIN_MISMATCH.description: The 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header value does not match the request 'Origin'.

ERR_CORS_MISSING_ALLOW_ORIGIN.title: Missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin
ERR_CORS_MISSING_ALLOW_ORIGIN.description: The server responded to a cross-origin request without an 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header.

ERR_CORS_METHOD_DISALLOWED.title: HTTP Method Disallowed by CORS
ERR_CORS_METHOD_DISALLOWED.description: The requested HTTP method is not permitted in 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods'.

ERR_CORS_HEADER_DISALLOWED.title: Header Not Allowed by CORS
ERR_CORS_HEADER_DISALLOWED.description: One or more custom request headers are not included in 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers'.

WARN_CORS_MISSING_VARY_ORIGIN.title: Missing 'Vary: Origin' Header
WARN_CORS_MISSING_VARY_ORIGIN.description: When dynamically reflecting request Origin, omitting 'Vary: Origin' causes cache poisoning across CDNs and browser caches.

WARN_CORS_EXCESSIVE_MAX_AGE.title: Access-Control-Max-Age Exceeds Browser Ceiling
WARN_CORS_EXCESSIVE_MAX_AGE.description: Max-Age exceeds browser maximum limits (Chromium caps at 2 hours / 7200s, Safari at 10 minutes / 600s).

WARN_CORS_UNEXPOSED_CUSTOM_HEADERS.title: Custom Response Headers Not Exposed
WARN_CORS_UNEXPOSED_CUSTOM_HEADERS.description: Custom response headers are present on the response but not declared in 'Access-Control-Expose-Headers', preventing frontend JavaScript from reading them.

INFO_CORS_PREFLIGHT_OK.title: Preflight OPTIONS Succeeded
INFO_CORS_PREFLIGHT_OK.description: Preflight handshake conforms to W3C Fetch specification.

presets.name: Public Static Web Fonts / Assets CDN
presets.description: Public CDN assets (fonts, images, WebAssembly) accessible from any origin without credentials.
